case_description: Đổi chất liệu hoặc kết cấu bề mặt của vật thể mục tiêu, giữ nguyên bối cảnh.

samples.text: Change the material of the building's wooden siding to a sleek, dark charcoal gray metal cladding with a subtle matte finish, ensuring the existing shadows from the tree and the overall lighting are realistically maintained on the new surface.

Change the wooden wall in all four panels to a dark, weathered red brick texture, ensuring the existing posters, murals, and artists are seamlessly integrated with appropriate shadows and lighting for a realistic appearance.

Change the material of the large wooden wall paneling to a dark, brushed metal finish with a subtle sheen, ensuring that the existing light reflections and shadows are realistically adapted to the new texture.

Change the material of the large castle structure from its current reddish-brown brick to a lighter, more weathered grey stone, ensuring the new texture seamlessly integrates with the existing lighting and shadows to maintain a realistic appearance.

Change the material of all visible seat covers from their current light brown fabric to a deep, rich burgundy velvet, ensuring the new texture realistically interacts with the existing ambient lighting and shadow details within the train car.
